# Colorado Boom Volleyball Club

> Colorado Boom is a junior club volleyball program based at Boomtown Fieldhouse, 14200 E Alameda Ave, Aurora, CO 80012, in the Denver metro area. It fields girls teams (10U to 18U) and boys teams (13U to 18U), sanctioned by USA Volleyball through the Rocky Mountain Region (RMR). It also runs skills training, camps and open gyms for youth players.

Practice changes, holiday breaks, tryout dates and open roster spots change often. The site pages and the club calendar are the source of truth for anything dated.

## Key facts

- Location: Boomtown Fieldhouse, 14200 E Alameda Ave, Aurora, CO 80012. The facility has 13 courts.
- Who it serves: girls 10U to 18U and boys 13U to 18U in club volleyball, plus younger players in skills classes starting at age 6.
- Sanctioning: USA Volleyball (USAV) and the Rocky Mountain Region (RMR).
- Girls club season: November to June.
- Boys club season: September to February, with an optional June extension for national-championship teams.
- Practice model: three days a week (Mon/Wed/Fri or Tue/Thu/Fri), 5:15 to 7:30 PM, always at one location. Open gym dates are posted on the club calendar.
- Team levels: Regional, Colorado and National. Committed travel and fees rise with the level.
- 2026-27 girls club fees: base club fee $4,500. Totals run from $4,500 to $6,000 depending on team level and committed travel. Family travel is separate. For boys fees, contact the club.
- RYL (Rocky Mountain Youth League): a fall league in September and October, included for rostered 14U and under club players.
- Tryouts: the 2026-27 season is under way and remaining roster spots are filled by private evaluation (email the club). 2027-28 tryouts will be announced in April 2027.
- A USA Volleyball / RMR membership is required to participate.
- Contact: admin@coloradoboom.com (email is the fastest way to reach the club), phone (720) 773-0067. Instagram: @coboomvb.
